engrave.dxf_note: DXF has no fill attribute: the engraved art is closed polylines on layer ENGRAVE, so set that layer to fill / raster in the laser software.
conventions: Cuts are kerf-offset; engraving is not.
Engraving stays at least 0.35 mm from every cut.
Lay every part on the bed outside face up. Parts flagged 'flipped' are mirrored in the cut + engrave files for this; the art is not mirrored.
The drawer faceplate glue-up outline of the cut-only files is left out of the cut + engrave files.

variants.label: FAX MACHINE solid
variants.notes: Display lettering kept solid black (Ben's style); other large solids get gap channels.

variants.label: FAX MACHINE outline + light fill
variants.notes: Lettering redrawn as a 0.9 mm outline with light coded hatching inside: much less burn time and charring than solid.

variants.label: With 'Fun For'
variants.notes: Full title. The lid through-slot (y 5.1-8.9 mm, front 76 mm) cuts through 'Fun For'.

variants.label: Without 'Fun For'
variants.notes: 'Fun For' removed so the lid slot crosses blank wood; the title reads 'Terrible Writers & Artists of All Ages'.

variants.label: Traced
variants.notes: Fit above the bottom finger-joint row (art bottom 4.6 mm above the bottom edge). '44' kept as drawn in the source.

variants.label: Snake head (A)
variants.notes: Head-anchored window: the mosaic snake head sits on the sliding lid; the cat is trimmed off.

variants.label: Full cat (C)
variants.notes: Cat-anchored window: the full cat and floral border survive at the rear of the top panel; the snake head is trimmed. The old blank grip-capsule patch is filled with wallpaper.
